defect_found: Also: write jobs were accounted as pending AFTER executor.submit, so a worker that started and decremented before submit returned left pending permanently non-zero, making every later drain look like a timeout. Accounting now precedes submit and is rolled back on submit failure.
strict_rule: ANY dropped or failed mandatory-sensor frame => CAPTURE_FRAME_DROP => capture INVALID
summary: Writer backpressure was invisible: _queue_write_job returned False on exhausted capacity and callbacks continued, so a lost mandatory frame could still read as a successful capture.
defect_2: _record_callback_frame initially conflated delivered frames with saved frames by writing _sensor_frame_counts; that counter means 'bytes reached disk' and is now left to _record_saved_frame alone.
